card.title: LANCASHIRE FUSILIERS
card.flavorText: The Lancashire Fusiliers was a line infantry regiment of the British Army that was active from 1688 to 1968. At the outbreak of WWII the regiment was stationed in British India and their first engagement was during the Burma Campaign where the 1st Battalion fought with the 77th Indian Infantry Brigade. The 2nd Battalion joined the British Expeditionary Forces and fought in Belgium and France before it was evacuated from Dunkirk. Parts of the 2nd Battalion participated in the Normandy landings during Operation Overlord and would later participate in two operations on French soil. In 1943 members of the Lancashire Fusiliers participated in the Italian Campaign and saw heavy fighting on the Gothic Line. In early 1945 parts of the regiment were sent to Palestine were they served for the rest of the war.
